description: What a full-chip integrator takes from this block: top cell, ports, artifact paths, measured area, maturity rung. Published as structured data at this fixed path (spec/integrator.json), not README prose. Companion to spec/consumers.md (requirement-row verdicts per consumer) and spec/target-spec.md (the ratified rows).
